objective: Prove that the doubling law, rule 60 and law (12, 12) commute with the translations of the original lattice, so a stage's balance is read exactly on the rings of one fundamental domain, tracking only their born cells; and that every ring born at a doubling is bound at every later lag of its stage (the transfer lemma), so only rings that lived through a run can fail; check the reduced reading against the full-state reading.
title: Balance is read on one territory
